svg.text: DreamerV3's RSSM predicts the frame (32×32), reward and value after each action.
Time runs down; the GRU steps h. The KL teaches the prior to predict the posterior's z.
frames: squared error summed over each frame's pixels
kl_dyn = KL(sg(q) ‖ p) trains the prior; kl_rep = KL(q ‖ sg(p)) the posterior
reward: predicted r against the real r, 1 once the demo's last frame is reached (symlog)
critic: v towards the λ-return of r and the slow critic's values (symlog)
All four train the RSSM, so (h, z) keeps what predicts rewards and values.
each KL at least 1 nat (free bits); z: 32 categoricals of 32 classes, or Gaussian
mini-FM acts in the dream for 16 steps
REINFORCE (DreamerV2): V − v weighs log π(a); no gradients in the world model.
After t = 0 each z is the prior's; the sim runs this mini-FM, one action per step.
